en.headline: SFC orders ChaPanda operator to suspend trading from Tuesday morning
en.dek: The regulator directed the Stock Exchange to halt dealings in Sichuan Baicha Baidao Industrial under rules covering potentially false or misleading documents.
body: The Securities and Futures Commission ordered a trading halt in the shares of Sichuan Baicha Baidao Industrial, the operator of the ChaPanda milk-tea chain, from 9 am on Tuesday.

According to an exchange filing, the SFC directed the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong to suspend all dealings under Rule 8(1) of the Securities and Futures (Stock Market Listing) Rules. The rule concerns documents or statements that may contain false, incomplete or misleading information in material respects.
Before the suspension, the company's shares last traded at about HK$4.04. The company, listed under stock code 2555, has not yet disclosed further details of the specific documents involved.

zh.headline: 證監會指令茶百道營運商周二早上起停牌
zh.dek: 監管機構指示聯交所根據涉及文件可能載有虛假或誤導資料的規則，暫停四川百茶百道實業股份買賣。
body: 證券及期貨事務監察委員會指令，茶百道營運商四川百茶百道實業股份有限公司的股份由周二上午九時起停止買賣。
聯交所公告顯示，證監會依據《證券及期貨（在證券市場上市）規則》第8(1)條，指示停止所有股份交易。該條例主要涉及與上市有關的文件或發行人發出的公告及陳述，在要項上可能載有虛假、不完整或具誤導性的資料。
停牌前公司股價約為4.04港元。股份代號2555的公司尚未進一步披露涉及的具體文件詳情。
